intent: ImplementTicket01T3Completion (engineer; bounded: exact files and edits given, <=40 reads before first edit)
instructions:
T3 has two verified gaps. Fix exactly these; no redesign, no new files outside the write roots.

GAP A — retention-namespace retirement is never wired (AC43 / R7). resultStore.retire has no production caller; the three inbound trigger paths only call ToolSurface.sweepRetainedResults (expiry/marker sweep), so a retired namespace keeps its records and installs no tombstone.

A1. internal/service/bounded_delivery.go — add, next to sweepRetainedResults (line ~265):
func (t *ToolSurface) retireRetainedResultNamespace(owner projectionOwner) {
	if owner.kind != projectionSession || owner.epoch == 0 {
		return
	}
	t.resultMu.Lock()
	defer t.resultMu.Unlock()
	if t.results == nil {
		return
	}
	t.results.retire(resultNamespace{sessionID: owner.sessionID, epoch: strconv.FormatUint(owner.epoch, 10)})
}
Comment it as R7's release-funded retirement trigger: a namespace holding no live record completes with zero store effect inside retire.

A2. internal/service/inbound.go — invoke it at all three trigger paths, inside the existing `h.options.ToolSurface != nil` guards:
  (1) cleanupRetiredOwners (line ~1161): inside `if owner.epoch != 0 && h.options.ToolSurface != nil` call h.options.ToolSurface.retireRetainedResultNamespace(owner) after cleanupRetiredOwner(owner).
  (2) missing-session rewrite branch (~813): inside `if retiredOwner.epoch != 0` add the same call after cleanupRetiredOwner(retiredOwner).
  (3) session DELETE branch (~966): same addition.
Keep the existing sweepRetainedResults calls.

A3. Terminal precedence (R10: namespace-retired precedes no-stamped-epoch). In deliverBoundedResult (bounded_delivery.go line ~23-27) the pre-check currently returns result_epoch_unresolved for every resolution failure. Change it to: resolution failure with owner.epoch == "" -> result_epoch_unresolved; resolution failure with a stamped epoch -> result_namespace_retired.

GAP B — two T3 oracles do not exist.

B1. internal/service/builtin_guidance_test.go — add TestRetrievalContractDocumented. Assert the published retrieve_result description (publishedBuiltinGuidance) is exactly the literal already declared in that file's exact-string map, and contains "handle", "page number", "total_pages", "bounded preview"; assert it contains neither "complete upstream" nor "complete original".

B2. internal/service/bounded_delivery_test.go — add TestInboundRetirementHooks with three subtests, one per trigger path, reusing the existing package-internal inbound harness (testInbound/requestFor/serve in inbound_bounds_test.go; sessionIssuingHandler issues session ids). Per subtest:
  - surface := a *ToolSurface whose results store is a newDeliveryOracle-style store with injected clock; drive session enrolment so the inbound record has a nonzero epoch, then commit one live record under the namespace the production path will retire (sdk session id + decimal epoch).
  - record aggregateBytes/entries before; fire the trigger; assert: entry removed, exactly one live tombstone, exact before/after aggregate delta (negative or equal, never positive), handle resolves invalid_handle afterwards.
  - late commit: an over-ceiling result for the retired namespace yields retention == "result_namespace_retired", no handle, zero aggregate delta; repeat after the tombstone clears (advance the injected clock past tombstone_ttl).
  - zero-effect variant: a trigger whose namespace holds no live record persists nothing (no tombstone, zero delta).
  The retired owner must come only from the production trigger; never inject it in the fixture.
  If the InboundHandler's session-enrolment path needs an initialized projection coordinator on the ToolSurface, initialize it the same way other package tests do; do not change production code to make the fixture simpler.

VERIFY (report exit codes and outputs verbatim):
  go build ./...
  go vet ./internal/service/
  go test ./internal/service/ -run 'TestInboundRetirementHooks|TestRetrievalContractDocumented|TestEpochUnresolvedNoHandle|TestHandleRejectionUniformHandler|TestTerminalPreviewsBounded' -count=1
  go test ./internal/service/ -count=1
  go test ./internal/observe/ -count=1
  go test ./cmd/mcp-bridge/ -count=1
Write COMPLETED receipt to .omp/artifacts/receipt_T3.json only if every command exits 0; otherwise report INCOMPLETE with the exact failing output and stop.
